Community

Economy

Set the currency, tune rewards and choose whether balances are separate for this server or shared globally.

Configurable per server

General

Enable the system and choose how balances are stored.

Enable economyDisabling it makes economy commands unavailable without deleting balances.
Switching scope changes which ledger is used. Existing server and global balances are kept separately. In global mode, use the same currency name and symbol on every participating server so shared balances stay understandable.
Show leaderboardAllow members to view the balance leaderboard.
Allow staff to reset balancesRestrict the reset command to recognised server staff.

Daily rewards

Set reward range, cooldown and streak bonuses.

Daily rewardAllow members to claim a reward periodically.
Enable streak bonusGive an extra bonus as members keep claiming.

Work rewards

Reward members for using the work command.

Enable workMembers can earn currency by working.
The reward is chosen randomly between the minimum and maximum. Cooldowns are stored per account and survive bot restarts.

Bank upgrades

Control how fast members can expand their bank.

Example: a cost multiplier of 0.5 means an upgrade costs half the current capacity. A capacity multiplier of 1.5 increases the capacity by 50%.

Transfers

Allow members to send currency to each other.

Allow transfersEnable give, pay and transfer commands.

Gambling & robbery

Turn risky games on or off and control their odds.

GamblingEnable the gamble command.
RobberyAllow members to attempt to rob another member's wallet.

Example commands

Members use your server prefix followed by these commands. The prefix is configured under Automations & Prefix.

.balance [member].bank [member].daily.work.deposit <amount>.withdraw <amount|all>.bankup.give <member> <amount>.gamble <amount>.rob <member>.baltop.cooldowns
Currency scope only changes the ledger used by Auralis. Keep backups before moving to a different economy model, and avoid switching scope unexpectedly during an event.
